title: Image Rotation Angle Estimation: Five Circular-Aware Methods Across Sixteen Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2603.25351v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic image rotation estimation is a key preprocessing step in many vision pipelines, yet challenging because angles have circular topology, creating boundary discontinuities that hinder standard regression. We present a comprehensive study of five circular-aware methods for global orientation estimation: three regression based (direct angle with circular loss, unit vector, phase-shifting coder) and two classification based (angular binning, circular Gaussian distribution). Using transfer learning from ImageNet-pretrained models, we evaluate them across sixteen modern architectures and two data regimes of natural images, small-scale DRC-D and large-scale COCO. Classification approaches are the stronger family, attaining the lowest error on thirteen of the sixteen DRC-D backbones. translated_title: 图像旋转角度估计：跨十六种架构的五种圆形感知方法
translated_abstract: 自动图像旋转估计是许多视觉流程中的关键预处理步骤，但由于角度具有圆形拓扑结构，会产生边界不连续性，从而阻碍标准回归方法的应用，因此这一任务颇具挑战性。我们对五种用于全局方向估计的圆形感知方法进行了全面研究：三种基于回归的方法（采用圆形损失的直接角度法、单位向量法、相位偏移编码法）和两种基于分类的方法（角度分箱法、圆形高斯分布法）。利用从ImageNet预训练模型进行的迁移学习，我们在十六种现代架构以及两种自然图像数据规模（小规模DRC-D和大规模COCO）上对这些方法进行了评估。分类方法整体表现更强，在十六个DRC-D主干网络中的十三个上取得了最低误差。决定性因素是能够编码角度邻域结构的监督方式：普通的交叉熵缺乏这一特性并会间歇性失效，而…
tldr: 该论文系统评估了五种圆形感知的图像旋转角度估计方法在十六种架构上的表现，发现基于分类的方法整体更优，其关键在于采用能够编码角度邻域结构的监督方式。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates five circular-aware image rotation angle estimation methods across sixteen architectures, finding that classification-based approaches perform better overall, with the key factor being supervision that encodes angular neighborhood structure.
